visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men, one in a black button-down and one in a white t-shirt, sit together on a yellow couch in a studio. The man on the left points to a smartphone held by the man on the right, while a laptop rests on the table before them. They are engaged in an animated conversation. (2) The scene transitions to a vertical TikTok video montage. It displays a fast-moving house tour filled with dense silver and white balloon decorations, Christmas lights, and a person dancing in a white fur coat. The camera moves rapidly through various rooms, showing detailed interior design. (3) The view returns to the two men in the studio. Both are laughing heartily, looking at the smartphone screen. The studio background is tidy, featuring a bookshelf with diverse objects and warm, bright lighting that highlights their expressive facial reactions and hand gestures. (4) A second TikTok video is shown on the phone screen. A man dressed as a wizard appears to fly on a broomstick across a suburban parking lot. The footage is bright and sunny, featuring a red car and green trees in the background as the man performs the illusion. (5) A purple and white promotional graphic for 'LEXUS MY FILM' overlays the screen. It features bold Traditional Chinese text and icons of film awards. Visuals of people filming with smartphones on tripods in scenic locations like a beach are briefly shown as part of the campaign. (6) The two hosts are seen again, continuing their discussion with enthusiasm. One host holds up three fingers while explaining a point. They appear to be in a high-arousal state, frequently smiling and gesturing towards each other and the devices on the table. (7) A final TikTok clip shows a completely black screen with a large white '1' in the center. The camera then cuts back to the men laughing uncontrollably. The video ends with a full-screen brand logo for LEXUS and the competition title against a white background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy Mandarin dialogue begins between two male speakers. Their voices are clear, with a fast speech rate and high pitch variability. An upbeat electronic BGM with a strong rhythmic pulse plays underneath, punctuated by short cartoonish sound effects that emphasize their laughter and reactions. (2) As the video showcases TikTok clips, a synthetic whoosh SFX marks the transition. The BGM remains constant but its texture becomes more prominent during visual-only segments. A brief snippet of female vocals singing a pop melody in English is audible as part of the featured TikTok audio. (3) The speakers' loudness increases as they reveal viewership numbers, followed by a 'ding' sound effect for emphasis. Their speech is characterized by high arousal and positive valence, with frequent overlapping laughter that blends with the continuous electronic beat of the background music. (4) A new phase is triggered by a sudden rhythmic change in the music as a promotional segment starts. The narration becomes more informative but maintains a friendly, professional tone. The ambient noise is minimal, suggesting a controlled studio environment with high spectral clarity and dynamic range. (5) A strategic silence occurs for half a second before revealing the top-ranking video, followed by a loud burst of laughter from both men. The BGM swells back in volume with a bright, percussive texture. The audio concludes with a distinctive brand stinger SFX and a gradual fade-out of the music.
